name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [master]
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

# Cancel superseded PR builds. Every push to master gets its own run.
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

env:
  CMAKE_BUILD_PARALLEL_LEVEL: 2
  CTEST_PARALLEL_LEVEL: 2

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [macos, macos-arm64, ubuntu]
        type: [shared, static]
        include:
          - { os: macos, runner: macos-26-intel }
          - { os: macos-arm64, runner: macos-26 }
          - { os: ubuntu, runner: ubuntu-latest }

    steps:
      - &checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          submodules: ${{ runner.os == 'macOS' && runner.arch == 'X64' }}

      - name: Install Ubuntu packages
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: sudo apt-get install -y libgmp-dev zlib1g-dev python3-dev

      - name: Install macOS packages
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: brew install gmp z3

      - &native_deps
        name: Install native dependencies
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: bash .github/ci/install-native-deps.sh

      - name: Configure
        env:
          PRESET: ${{ runner.os == 'macOS' && 'ci-macos' || 'ci-ubuntu' }}
          SHARED: ${{ matrix.type == 'shared' }}
        run: |
          python3 -m venv "$RUNNER_TEMP/venv"
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/venv/bin/python" -m pip install pytest 'nanobind>=3.1,<4'
          cmake --preset "$PRESET" -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS="$SHARED" \
            -DPython3_EXECUTABLE="$RUNNER_TEMP/venv/bin/python" \
            -DCMAKE_INSTALL_RPATH_USE_LINK_PATH=ON

      - name: Build and test
        run: |
          cmake --build build
          ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure --no-tests=error

      - name: Test the installed C++ and Python packages
        run: |
          prefix="$RUNNER_TEMP/venv"
          cmake --install build --prefix "$prefix"
          cmake -S tests/find-package -B build/consumer -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
            -DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH="$prefix"
          cmake --build build/consumer
          ./build/consumer/maat_find_package_test
          "$prefix/bin/python" -I -c 'from maat import ARCH, MaatEngine; MaatEngine(ARCH.X64)'

      - name: Check the runtime and generated stub without Z3
        if: matrix.os == 'ubuntu' && matrix.type == 'shared'
        run: |
          cmake -S . -B build -Dmaat_USE_Z3=OFF
          cmake --build build --target maat_python_stub
          export PYTHONPATH=build MAAT_SLEIGH_DIR="$PWD/build/processors" MAAT_TEST_NO_SOLVER=1
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/venv/bin/python" -m pytest -q tests/python-tests/test_package.py \
            tests/python-tests/test_typed_scripts.py

  sanitize:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - *checkout

      - name: Install Ubuntu packages
        run: sudo apt-get install -y libgmp-dev zlib1g-dev python3-dev

      - *native_deps

      - name: Configure and build
        env:
          CC: clang
          CXX: clang++
        run: |
          python3 -m venv "$RUNNER_TEMP/venv"
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/venv/bin/python" -m pip install 'nanobind>=3.1,<4'
          cmake --preset ci-sanitize -DPython3_EXECUTABLE="$RUNNER_TEMP/venv/bin/python"
          # Stub generation imports the extension and needs an ASan-instrumented interpreter.
          cmake --build build/sanitize --target unit-tests adv-tests maat_python

      - name: Test with AddressSanitizer and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer
        env:
          ASAN_OPTIONS: strict_string_checks=1:detect_stack_use_after_return=1:check_initialization_order=1:strict_init_order=1:detect_leaks=1
          UBSAN_OPTIONS: print_stacktrace=1
        run: ctest --test-dir build/sanitize --output-on-failure --no-tests=error

case "$RUNNER_OS/$RUNNER_ARCH" in

  lief_sha=81b86bcc69d311a01ec1914d26c31ebbb605ac761ec02f10bc5b588de74a8e91
  sleigh_sha=04aeb501858bbacb1cf7afd75d85a94cd1c1abf00354ce43ffaa1e26e2d55ba8
  ;;
macOS/X64)
  lief_sha=f15541e53344b3bb58078472bd9ab737b9f89cd24d51f46866066e554ead7107
  ;;
macOS/ARM64)
  lief_sha=c7bedf2e2acab9bced1c8701b06261fc6f4eba1957f80cbf86323a3f5e172167
  sleigh_sha=6958f37ba8fd5dfd1ce93397f270380f314c8081a132d1e14753c7baef58b8bc
  ;;
*)
  echo "Unsupported runner: $RUNNER_OS/$RUNNER_ARCH" >&2

cd "$RUNNER_TEMP"
prefix="$RUNNER_TEMP/native-deps"
mkdir -p "$prefix"

install_archive() {
  local repo=$1 tag=$2 archive=$3 digest=$4
  gh release download "$tag" --repo "$repo" --pattern "$archive"
  printf '%s  %s\n' "$digest" "$archive" | shasum -a 256 --check
  tar -xzf "$archive" --strip-components=1 -C "$prefix"
}

lief_version=1.0.0
install_archive lief-project/LIEF "$lief_version" "LIEF-$lief_version-$(uname -s)-$(uname -m).tar.gz" "$lief_sha"

  install_archive lifting-bits/sleigh v12.2 "$RUNNER_OS-sleigh-12.2-1.$(uname -m).tar.gz" "$sleigh_sha"
else
  # Sleigh publishes its macOS binary for arm64. Build the Intel library locally.
  cmake -S "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/src/third-party/sleigh/sleigh-cmake" -B sleigh-build \
    -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX="$prefix" \
    -Dsleigh_BUILD_SLEIGHSPECS=OFF -Dsleigh_BUILD_SUPPORT=OFF
  cmake --build sleigh-build --target install
fi

if [[ $RUNNER_OS == Linux ]]; then
  z3='z3-5.4.1-x64-glibc-2.39'
  gh release download z3-5.4.1 --repo Z3Prover/z3 --pattern "$z3.zip"
  echo "b548bac48ef2452b4e09ea2945cf4b011d5f43fcf39e4799df268ee7e0769d85  $z3.zip" | sha256sum --check
  unzip -q "$z3.zip"
  prefix="$prefix:$RUNNER_TEMP/$z3"
fi
echo "CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=$prefix" >>"$GITHUB_ENV"

name: Python wheels

on:
  push:
    branches: [master]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:
  release:
    types: [published]

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: wheels-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

jobs:
  wheels:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - { runner: ubuntu-latest, platform: manylinux_x86_64 }
          - { runner: macos-26-intel, platform: macosx_x86_64, deployment: '14.0' }
          - { runner: macos-26, platform: macosx_arm64, deployment: '14.0' }
    name: Wheels (${{ matrix.platform }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          submodules: true
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@f87e5991a6d7451dcb8d9637bfbc97413f497069 # v4.4.1

      - name: Load manylinux image with native dependencies
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        uses: docker/build-push-action@c3c9e263c25d99ce0380d002d59b67737d91b0dc # v7.4.0
        env:
          DOCKER_BUILD_RECORD_UPLOAD: false
        with:
          context: .
          file: .github/ci/wheel-deps.Dockerfile
          tags: maat-wheel-deps:manylinux_2_28
          load: true
          cache-from: ${{ github.event_name != 'release' && 'type=gha,scope=maat-wheels-manylinux_2_28-x86_64' || '' }}
          cache-to: ${{ github.event_name != 'release' && 'type=gha,mode=max,scope=maat-wheels-manylinux_2_28-x86_64' || '' }}

      - name: Identify macOS build inputs
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        id: inputs
        run: |
          {
            xcodebuild -version
            xcrun --sdk macosx --show-sdk-build-version
            xcrun clang --version
            git rev-parse HEAD:src/third-party/sleigh/sleigh-cmake
          } > "$RUNNER_TEMP/wheel-build-inputs"
          digest=$(shasum -a 256 "$RUNNER_TEMP/wheel-build-inputs" | cut -d' ' -f1)
          echo "digest=$digest" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Cache macOS native dependencies
        if: runner.os == 'macOS' && github.event_name != 'release'
        # Release jobs skip this step and compile their own dependencies.
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0 # zizmor: ignore[cache-poisoning]
        id: deps
        with:
          path: /tmp/maat-wheel-deps
          key: wheel-deps-${{ matrix.runner }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ matrix.deployment }}-${{ steps.inputs.outputs.digest }}-${{ hashFiles('.github/ci/install-wheel-deps.sh') }}

      - name: Build macOS native dependencies
        if: runner.os == 'macOS' && steps.deps.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        env:
          MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET: ${{ matrix.deployment }}
          CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH: /tmp/maat-wheel-deps
          CMAKE_BUILD_PARALLEL_LEVEL: 4
        run: bash .github/ci/install-wheel-deps.sh .

      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@68559e99cc807c1eb7e9238fd43a15bba460eec2 # v10.3.3
        with:
          version: '0.13.9'
          enable-cache: false

      - name: Build, repair, and test wheels
        env:
          CIBW_BEFORE_ALL: "true"
          CIBW_MANYLINUX_X86_64_IMAGE: maat-wheel-deps:manylinux_2_28
          MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET: ${{ matrix.deployment }}
        run: uvx --python 3.13 --from 'cibuildwheel[uv]==4.3.5' cibuildwheel

      - name: Load a wheel built with Python 3.15 headers on Python 3.12
        if: matrix.platform == 'macosx_arm64'
        env:
          MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET: ${{ matrix.deployment }}
          CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH: /tmp/maat-wheel-deps
          CMAKE_BUILD_PARALLEL_LEVEL: 4
        run: |
          wheels="$RUNNER_TEMP/newest-headers"
          uv build --wheel --python 3.15 --out-dir "$wheels" \
            -Ccmake.define.maat_USE_EXTERNAL_SLEIGH=ON -Ccmake.define.CMAKE_INSTALL_RPATH_USE_LINK_PATH=ON
          uv venv --python 3.12 "$RUNNER_TEMP/minimum"
          python="$RUNNER_TEMP/minimum/bin/python"
          uv pip install --python "$python" pytest "$wheels"/*.whl
          "$python" -I -m pytest -q tests/python-tests

      - name: Check wheel typing with ty, mypy, and Pyright
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          uv venv --python 3.12 "$RUNNER_TEMP/checkers"
          python="$RUNNER_TEMP/checkers/bin/python"
          uv pip install --python "$python" wheelhouse/*.whl pytest ty==0.0.103 mypy==2.4.1 pyright==1.1.414
          "$python" tests/typing/check.py

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: wheels-${{ matrix.platform }}
          path: wheelhouse/*-cp312-abi3-*.whl
          if-no-files-found: error

  publish:
    if: github.event_name == 'release' && github.event.action == 'published'
    needs: wheels
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: pypi
      url: https://pypi.org/p/pymaat
    permissions:
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          pattern: wheels-*
          merge-multiple: true
          path: dist
      - uses: pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish@7245906fb61fa33a13554f9d5fb856fe61758086 # v1.14.3

RESOURCES_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "resources"
LINUX_LIBS_64_DIR = f"{RESOURCES_DIR}/linux_libs_64/"
X64_ELF_DIR = f"{RESOURCES_DIR}/x64_elf"

def test_crackme1():
    """This tests the example we give in our dynamic symbolic execution tutorial.
       The target program computes a serial from the user input, and checks it against
       a hardcoded value. 

       This script hooks the conditional jump after the serial comparison and uses the
       solver to find the correct serial that leads to a jump to the "success" branch
    """

    m = MaatEngine(ARCH.X64, OS.LINUX)
    m.load(
        f"{X64_ELF_DIR}/crackme1",
        BIN.ELF64,
        base=0x4000000,
        libdirs=[LINUX_LIBS_64_DIR]
    )

    stdin = m.env.fs.get_fa_by_handle(0)
    buf = m.vars.new_concolic_buffer(
        "input",
        b'aaaaaaaa',
        nb_elems=8,
        elem_size=1,
        trailing_value=ord('\n')
    )
    stdin.write_buffer(buf)

    # NOTE: data argument is unnecessary but we use it to test
    # callback data in python 
    def solve_chall(m: MaatEngine, data):
        if m.info.addr != 0x040008b1:
            return
        s = Solver()
        s.add(m.info.branch.cond.invert())
        if s.check():
            model = s.get_model()
            m.vars.update_from(model)
        return ACTION.HALT

    m.hooks.add(EVENT.PATH, WHEN.BEFORE, callbacks=[solve_chall], data=None)
    m.run()

    assert m.vars.get_as_str("input") == b'1bHt56z0'

import ast

def test_typed_package():
    package = Path(maat.__file__).parent
    if os.name == "posix":
        assert Path(maat._native.__file__).name == "_native.abi3.so"
    assert (package / "py.typed").is_file()
    declarations = ast.parse((package / "_native.pyi").read_text()).body
    functions = [node for node in declarations if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef)]
    solver_enabled = os.environ.get("MAAT_TEST_NO_SOLVER") != "1"
    assert hasattr(maat, "Solver") == solver_enabled
    assert (
        any(
            isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef) and node.name == "Solver"
            for node in declarations
        )
        == solver_enabled
    )
    for name in ("ULT", "ULE", "ITE"):
        assert any(fn.name == name and ast.get_docstring(fn) for fn in functions)

import maat

def engine_with_nops():
    engine = maat.MaatEngine(maat.ARCH.X64)
    engine.mem.map(0x1000, 0x1FFF)
    engine.mem.write(0x1000, b"\x90\x90")
    return engine


def test_duplicated_hooks_keep_callback_and_data():
    parent = engine_with_nops()
    calls = []

    class Payload:
        pass

    def record(engine, *args):
        calls.append((engine, args))

    data = Payload()
    callback_ref, data_ref = weakref.ref(record), weakref.ref(data)
    for kwargs in ({}, {"data": None}, {"data": data}):
        parent.hooks.add(
            maat.EVENT.EXEC, maat.WHEN.BEFORE, callbacks=[record], **kwargs
        )
    child = parent._duplicate(share={"mem"}, duplicate={"hooks"})
    del parent, record, data, kwargs
    assert callback_ref() is not None and data_ref() is not None
    assert child.run_from(0x1000, 1) == maat.STOP.INST_COUNT
    assert all(engine is child for engine, _ in calls)
    assert [args for _, args in calls] == [(), (None,), (data_ref(),)]
    calls.clear()
    del child
    assert callback_ref() is None and data_ref() is None


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("result", "stop"),
    [
        (None, maat.STOP.INST_COUNT),
        (maat.ACTION.HALT, maat.STOP.HOOK),
        (maat.ACTION.ERROR, maat.STOP.FATAL),
        (9, maat.STOP.FATAL),
        ("bad", maat.STOP.FATAL),
    ],
)
def test_callback_actions(result, stop):
    engine = engine_with_nops()
    engine.hooks.add(maat.EVENT.EXEC, maat.WHEN.BEFORE, callbacks=[lambda _: result])
    assert engine.run_from(0x1000, 1) == stop


def test_callback_exception(capfd, monkeypatch):
    # Printing the callback traceback sets these interpreter-wide attributes.
    for name in ("last_exc", "last_type", "last_value", "last_traceback"):
        monkeypatch.setattr(sys, name, None, raising=False)

    def fail(engine):
        raise ValueError("test callback failed")

    engine = engine_with_nops()
    engine.hooks.add(maat.EVENT.EXEC, maat.WHEN.BEFORE, callbacks=[fail])
    assert engine.run_from(0x1000, 1) == maat.STOP.FATAL
    assert "ValueError: test callback failed" in capfd.readouterr().err

def test_symbolic_register_in_execution_hook() -> None:
    engine = maat.MaatEngine(maat.ARCH.X64)
    engine.mem.map(0x1000, 0x1FFF)
    engine.mem.write(0x1000, b"\x48\x83\xc0\x03")  # add rax, 3
    engine.cpu.rax = maat.Var(64, "input")
    observed: list[maat.Value] = []

    def after_instruction(current: maat.MaatEngine) -> None:
        observed.append(current.cpu.rax)

    engine.hooks.add(maat.EVENT.EXEC, maat.WHEN.AFTER, callbacks=[after_instruction])
    assert engine.run_from(0x1000, 1) == maat.STOP.INST_COUNT
    (output,) = observed
    model = solve_for_output(maat.Solver(), output, 10)
    engine.vars.update_from(model)
    assert model.get("input") == 7
    assert engine.cpu.rax.as_uint() == 10


def call_contract(
    deployed: maat.MaatEngine, tx: maat.EVMTransaction
) -> maat.MaatEngine:
    runtime = deployed._duplicate(share={"mem", "vars", "path"})
    maat.new_evm_runtime(runtime, deployed)
    maat.contract(runtime).transaction = tx
    runtime.run()
    return runtime


def test_deployed_contract_getter() -> None:
    engine = maat.MaatEngine(maat.ARCH.EVM)
    path = (
        Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "resources/smart_contracts/HelloWorld.bin"
    )
    engine.load(str(path), envp={"address": "123", "deployer": "456"})
    sender, zero = maat.Cst(160, 0x456), maat.Cst(256, 0)
    selector = bytes.fromhex("e21f37ce")  # message()
    tx = maat.EVMTransaction(
        sender,
        sender,
        0x123,
        zero,
        [maat.Cst(8, b) for b in selector],
        zero,
        maat.Cst(256, 100000),
    )
    runtime = call_contract(engine, tx)
    assert isinstance(runtime, maat.MaatEngine)
    completed = maat.contract(runtime).transaction
    assert isinstance(completed, maat.EVMTransaction) and completed.result is not None
    assert completed.result.type == maat.TX_RES.RETURN
    payload = b"".join(
        v.as_uint().to_bytes(v.size // 8, "big") for v in completed.result.return_data
    )
    offset = int.from_bytes(payload[:32], "big")
    size = int.from_bytes(payload[offset : offset + 32], "big")
    expected = b"Hello world" + b"!" * 55
    assert size == len(expected)
    assert payload[offset + 32 : offset + 32 + size] == expected

    other = original.deepcopy()
    other.data = [maat.Cst(8, 99)]

    setattr(contract, field, replacement)
    assert [item.as_uint() for item in view.data] == [42]
    assert [item.as_uint() for item in other_view.data] == [99]
    setattr(contract, field, None)
    with pytest.raises(AttributeError):
        _ = view.data
    assert [item.as_uint() for item in other_view.data] == [99]

import pytest

RESOURCES_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "resources"
X86_ELF_DIR = f"{RESOURCES_DIR}/x86_elf"

def test_crackme_vm():
    """This solves a challenge by exploring all possible execution paths.
       The challenge asks for a password and checks it with obfuscated code. The
       obfuscation consists in a VM protection using Z80 opcodes.

       This script implements DFS path exploration using snapshots.
    """
    m = MaatEngine(ARCH.X86, OS.LINUX)
    m.load(f"{X86_ELF_DIR}/crackme_vm", BIN.ELF32, load_interp=False)

    snapshot_next = True
    def path_cb(m: MaatEngine):
        nonlocal snapshot_next
        if snapshot_next:
            m.take_snapshot()
        snapshot_next = True

    def explore(m: MaatEngine):
        nonlocal snapshot_next
        while m.run() == STOP.HOOK:
            while True:
                # Restore last snapshot and invert branch
                m.restore_snapshot(remove=True)
                s = Solver()
                for c in m.path.get_related_constraints(m.info.branch.cond):
                    s.add(c)
                if m.info.branch.taken:
                    s.add(m.info.branch.cond.invert())
                else:
                    s.add(m.info.branch.cond)
                if s.check():
                    m.vars.update_from(s.get_model())
                    snapshot_next = False
                    break

    # Exploration hooks
    m.hooks.add(EVENT.PATH, WHEN.BEFORE, name="path", callbacks=[path_cb])
    m.hooks.add(EVENT.EXEC, WHEN.BEFORE, name="fail", filter=0x8048411)

    # Scanf hook
    def scanf(m: MaatEngine):
        _input = b"aaaaaaaaaaaapcod3s_aaaaaaaa"
        m.mem.write(0x8049a98, _input)
        m.mem.make_concolic(0x8049a98, len(_input), 1, "input")
        m.cpu.eax = len(_input)
        m.info.addr = m.mem.read(m.cpu.esp, 4).as_uint()
        m.cpu.esp += 4

    m.hooks.add(EVENT.EXEC, WHEN.BEFORE, name="scanf", filter=0x8048a6c, callbacks=[scanf])

    # Explore
    explore(m)

    assert m.vars.get_as_str("input") == b'I_L0v3_Z80_Opcod3s_!'


def test_crackme_vm_serialization():
    """This solves a challenge by exploring all possible execution paths.

       The challenge asks for a password and checks it with obfuscated code. The
       obfuscation consists in a VM protection using Z80 opcodes.

       This script implements BFS path exploration using state serialization.
    """
    state_manager = SimpleStateManager(".")
    snapshot_next = True
    def path_cb(m: MaatEngine):
        nonlocal snapshot_next
        nonlocal state_manager
        if snapshot_next:
            # Check if we can invert the branch condition
            s = Solver()
            for c in m.path.get_related_constraints(m.info.branch.cond):
                s.add(c)
            if m.info.branch.taken:
                s.add(m.info.branch.cond.invert())
            else:
                s.add(m.info.branch.cond)
            if s.check():
                # We found a model that inverts the branch condition
                model = s.get_model()
                # Save current state for later execution
                state_manager.enqueue_state(m)
                # Update symbolic variables to explore the other branch first
                m.vars.update_from(model)

        snapshot_next = True

    def explore(m: MaatEngine):
        nonlocal snapshot_next
        nonlocal state_manager

        # Exploration hooks
        m.hooks.add(EVENT.PATH, WHEN.BEFORE, name="path", callbacks=[path_cb])
        m.hooks.add(EVENT.EXEC, WHEN.BEFORE, name="fail", filter=0x8048411)

        while m.run() == STOP.HOOK:
            if not state_manager.dequeue_state(m):
                break
            snapshot_next = False

    # Scanf hook
    def scanf(m: MaatEngine):
        _input = b"aaaaaaaaaaaapcod3s_aaaaaaaa"
        m.mem.write(0x8049a98, _input)
        m.mem.make_concolic(0x8049a98, len(_input), 1, "input")
        m.cpu.eax = len(_input)
        m.info.addr = m.mem.read(m.cpu.esp, 4).as_uint()
        m.cpu.esp += 4

    # Initialize engine
    m = MaatEngine(ARCH.X86, OS.LINUX)
    m.load(f"{X86_ELF_DIR}/crackme_vm", BIN.ELF32, load_interp=False)
    m.hooks.add(EVENT.EXEC, WHEN.BEFORE, name="scanf", filter=0x8048a6c, callbacks=[scanf])
    
    # Explore
    explore(m)

    assert m.vars.get_as_str("input") == b'I_L0v3_Z80_Opcod3s_!'
